  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728 used by org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728
    Class
    Description
    AudioContent
    MCP audio content block (base64 data).
    BlobResourceContents
    Base64 blob body for resources/read results or embedded resource content.
    CacheableResult
    Shared SEP-2549 cache-hint base for the five cacheable 2026-07-28 result carriers (tools/list, prompts/list, resources/list, resources/templates/list, and resources/read).
    CallToolRequest
    Parameters for "tools/call".
    CallToolResult
    Result payload for "tools/call".
    ClientCapabilities
    MCP client capability advertisement carried by RequestMeta.
    CompleteRequest
    Parameters for "completion/complete".
    CompleteResult
    Result payload for "completion/complete".
    Completion
    Completion values for a "completion/complete" request.
    CompletionArgument
    Identifies the prompt argument or resource-template variable being completed, and its current partial value.
    CompletionCapability
    Empty marker capability advertising "completion/complete" support (structure may grow with the spec).
    CompletionContext
    Optional already-resolved argument values supplied alongside a completion/complete request.
    CompletionReference
    Polymorphic "completion/complete" target reference (prompt or resource template).
    Content
    Polymorphic MCP content block (tool results, prompt messages).
    CreateMessageRequest
    Parameters for "sampling/createMessage", a server-to-client duplex request (MCP sampling).
    CreateMessageResult
    Result payload for "sampling/createMessage" (MCP sampling).
    ElicitAction
    Closed action set for an elicitation answer (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322).
    ElicitationCapability
    Client elicitation capability (SEP-2322): presence on ClientCapabilities.getElicitation() signals the client understands input_required elicitation-flavored requests.
    ElicitRequest
    One entry of an input_required pause's inputRequests map for an elicitation sub-request (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322), built by a tools/call/prompts/get/resources/read handler and placed via org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.ElicitationRequests.
    ElicitResult
    The end user's answer to an ElicitRequest (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322), echoed back keyed by the same server-assigned id in a follow-up request's inputResponses and decoded via org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728.ElicitationResponses.
    ElicitSchema
    Fluent builder for a restricted elicitation JSON Schema (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322), producing the JsonMap consumed by ElicitRequest.setRequestedSchema(java.util.Map).
    EmbeddedResourceContent
    MCP resource content block (inline resource body).
    GetPromptRequest
    Parameters for "prompts/get".
    GetPromptResult
    Result payload for "prompts/get".
    Icon
    MCP icon descriptor (the schema's Icons.icons entry shape), used by Implementation.
    Icon.Theme
    Icon color-scheme hint, restricted to the schema's two legal values (MCP wire uses lowercase strings).
    ImageContent
    MCP image content block (base64 data).
    Implementation
    MCP Implementation object (BaseMetadata + Icons per the schema): required name / version, plus optional title, description, and ordered icons.
    InputRequiredResult
    Result of a tools/call, prompts/get, or resources/read handler pausing to request more input (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322 Multi-Round-Trip Requests).
    ListPromptsResult
    Result payload for "prompts/list".
    ListResourcesResult
    Result payload for "resources/list".
    ListResourceTemplatesResult
    Result payload for "resources/templates/list".
    ListToolsResult
    Result payload for "tools/list".
    LoggingCapability
    Server logging capability marker (structure may grow with the spec).
    McpCacheScope
    SEP-2549 cache-hint authorization scope for a CacheableResult (MCP wire uses lowercase strings).
    ModelHint
    A model family/name hint for ModelPreferences.getHints() (MCP sampling).
    ModelPreferences
    Model-selection preferences for CreateMessageRequest (MCP sampling).
    Prompt
    MCP prompt descriptor (prompts/list entry).
    PromptArgument
    Declared argument for an MCP prompt.
    PromptCapability
    Server capability flags for prompts.
    PromptMessage
    Single message line inside GetPromptResult.
    PromptReference
    CompletionReference targeting a declared prompt by name.
    ReadResourceRequest
    Parameters for "resources/read".
    ReadResourceResult
    Result payload for "resources/read".
    RequestMeta
    Opaque per-request MCP metadata carried under the JSON-RPC params._meta property.
    RequestParams
    CRTP base for MCP 2026-07-28 request params carrying optional negotiation/trace metadata under the reserved _meta wire key.
    Resource
    MCP resource descriptor (resources/list entry).
    ResourceCapability
    Server capability flags for resources.
    ResourceContents
    Polymorphic MCP resource body (text or base64 blob).
    ResourceTemplate
    MCP resource-template descriptor (resources/templates/list entry).
    ResourceTemplateReference
    CompletionReference targeting a registered resource template by its exact URI-template string.
    ResourceUpdatedNotification
    Params for the notifications/resources/updated notification: a specific subscribed resource's content changed.
    Result
    CRTP base for every successful MCP 2026-07-28 result, carrying the required resultType discriminator and optional ResultMeta under the reserved _meta wire key.
    ResultMeta
    Opaque per-result MCP metadata carried under the JSON-RPC result._meta property.
    Role
    Role for PromptMessage entries (MCP wire uses lowercase strings).
    RootsCapability
    Client roots capability.
    SamplingCapability
    Client sampling capability marker (MCP sampling): presence on ClientCapabilities.getSampling() signals the client understands "sampling/createMessage".
    SamplingMessage
    One message in CreateMessageRequest.getMessages() (MCP sampling).
    ServerCapabilities
    MCP server capability advertisement returned by ServerDiscoverResult.
    ServerDiscoverResult
    Result payload for "server/discover".
    SubscriptionFilter
    Wire filter for subscriptions/listen: which notification kinds and resource URIs a client wants (see SubscriptionsListenRequest.getNotifications()), or the honored subset a server actually granted (see SubscriptionsAcknowledgedNotification.getNotifications()).
    SubscriptionsAcknowledgedNotification
    Mandatory first frame on every accepted subscriptions/listen stream: echoes the honored subset of the client's requested SubscriptionFilter (after capability gating).
    SubscriptionsListenRequest
    Request params for subscriptions/listen (SEP-2575): the requested notification filter.
    TextContent
    MCP text content block.
    TextResourceContents
    Text body for resources/read results or embedded resource content.
    Tool
    MCP tool descriptor (tools/list entry).
    ToolCapability
    Server capability flags for tools.
